programs.rightsClaimSummary: Praxis June 2026 Form 10-Q describes in-house Cerebrum relutrigine development and accepted NDA. Asset-specific exclusive license or full unencumbered legal ownership terms have not been independently adjudicated. Do not reassign RogCon SCN2A gene-program license mentioned elsewhere in the same filing to this drug without drug-specific contract evidence.

sourceDocuments.assertion: Praxis Q2 2026 10-Q identifies relutrigine EMBOLD registrational cohort for SCN2A/SCN8A DEE, accepted priority-review NDA, extension from Sep 27 to Dec 27 after sensitivity-analysis major amendment, EMERALD broader DEE potential later sNDA; filing separately discusses other SCN2A program licenses, not independently established relutrigine terms.

Praxis June 29 Form 8-K reports FDA revised relutrigine SCN2A/SCN8A NDA goal date from Sep 27 to Dec 27, 2026 after company-submitted major amendment, no new study requested. This supersedes older Sep 27 issuer-reported date.
Praxis August 6 release confirms December 27, 2026 relutrigine PDUFA goal, EMBOLD support, and EMERALD data intended for potential future broader-etiology sNDA.
Praxis March 30 release documents relutrigine NDA accepted for priority review; original Sep 27 2026 action date is now superseded by June 29 SEC 8-K.
NCT05818553 Phase 2/3 EMBOLD tests PRAX-562 relutrigine in SCN2A and SCN8A developmental and epileptic encephalopathies; primary trial linked to current accepted original NDA.
NCT07010471 Phase 3 EMERALD tests relutrigine in broader DEEs; may support a different future supplemental application, not the Dec 27 accepted original NDA.

trialLinks.indication: SCN2A and SCN8A developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs)
Broader developmental and epileptic encephalopathies independent of SCN2A/SCN8A genotype

programs.rightsClaimSummary: Praxis June 2026 10-Q states Tenacia holds exclusive ulixacaltamide development and commercialization IP license for China, Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan; company is developing US essential tremor NDA. Exact remaining geography and legal enforceability not independently adjudicated.

sourceDocuments.assertion: Praxis Q2 Form 10-Q identifies US ulixacaltamide NDA based on two Essential3 trials, accepted for review with Jan 29 2027 PDUFA goal. It also discloses Tenacia January 2024 exclusive license for ulixacaltamide China/Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan.
Praxis August 6 company statement reports Jan 29, 2027 ulixacaltamide essential tremor PDUFA, no current advisory committee planned; no approval prediction.
Praxis Q1 release states FDA accepted ulixacaltamide essential tremor NDA with January 29, 2027 goal.
NCT06087276 is the Phase 3 decentralized Essential3 trial of ulixacaltamide in essential tremor; it is not the totality of the two-trial application package.

limitations: Only three exact saved 741-census Praxis NCTs are used: EMBOLD and EMERALD relutrigine, and one Essential3 decentralized ulixacaltamide study. Original relutrigine Sept 27 target has been superseded by issuer-filed June 29 extension to Dec 27 2026; separate ulixacaltamide Jan 29 2027 goal. Both are company SEC-reported FDA review goals, not independent FDA goal letters or approvals. Contracts, especially relutrigine rights and Tenacia regional constraints, remain not independently adjudicated. No qualification or trade authorization.
